about: #4628: each surviving det-port mutant stated `equivalent` or `unreachable`, with the Java change and why it cannot alter observable behaviour; proposed in a PR, reviewed by the owner. A run that kills a stated mutant fails (the claim was wrong). Ids are mutation.py's; before / after are the Java line.

verdicts.equivalent: the change cannot alter anything the program shows (output, screen, files, COMMAREA, abend)
verdicts.unreachable: no input of the program reaches the changed code
verdicts.undefined-by-ibm: only non-digit data in a numeric USAGE DISPLAY item kills it, and IBM documents no result for that
verdicts.harness-gap: the change alters behaviour the proof runs but does not compare (open: the harness must)
verdicts.case-gap: an input the case lacks would kill it (open: strengthen the case)

survivors.reason: GOTO is only ORed on, tested and cleared as one flag bit: bit 21 is as good as bit 20 (goto-flag-bit)
image byte(s) [0] of s_WS_SQLCODE_DISP lie in no item the program names (inert-image)
image byte(s) [0] of s_EXIT_IMS_READ lie in no item the program names (inert-image)
image byte(s) [0] of s_WS_INVOKING_PROGRAM lie in no item the program names (inert-image)

survivors.before: private final Field f9_CUSTOMER_EYECATCHER = Field.alphanumeric(s_OUTPUT_DATA, 0, 4, false);
survivors.after: private final Field f9_CUSTOMER_EYECATCHER = Field.alphanumeric(s_OUTPUT_DATA, 0, 5, false);
survivors.reason: field_observability: truncated: CUSTOMER-EYECATCHER is only ever moved whole into alphanumeric items of at most 4 bytes, so its 4 or 5 bytes give them the same leading bytes (solver-unobservable)

survivors.before: private final Field f131_EIBTIME = Field.packed(s_DFHEIBLK, 0, 7, 0, true);
survivors.after: private final Field f131_EIBTIME = Field.packed(s_DFHEIBLK, 0, 8, 0, true);
survivors.reason: f131_EIBTIME is only stored into: bytes 0..4 of s_DFHEIBLK are in no read EIB item (eib-resp-unread)
every read of s_MY_ABEND_CODE's items follows a top-level Cobol.store in its own method; initial image is never read (inert-image)
every read of s_HIGHEST_CUST_NUMBER's items follows a top-level Cobol.store in its own method; initial image is never read (inert-image)
f102_EIBRESP is only stored into and no read EIB item shares its bytes: the stored value is never seen (eib-resp-unread)
